Verses.1: My siblings, who are spiritual, listen. Even if someone is caught in any wrongdoing, you should restore that person with a gentle spirit. Watch out for yourselves, so that you are not also tempted.
Verses.2: Carry one another's burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.
Verses.3: For if anyone thinks they are something when they are nothing, they deceive themselves.
Verses.4: But each one must examine their own actions. Then they can find pride within themselves, without comparison to someone else.
Verses.5: For each one will have to carry their own load.

Changes: 2025-02-03 - Paul Prins: First translation of verses 1-5 based on Greek.
